admin.title: Institution well-being overview
admin.subtitle: Aggregate, anonymous trends for your institution. No individual student is ever shown.
admin.privacy: Only groups of {{k}} or more students are shown. Smaller groups are hidden and appear as "fewer than {{k}} students". This view has no names, no messages and no individual records.
admin.loadError: We could not load the analytics. Please try again.
admin.forbidden: Only institution admins can see this page.
admin.noInstitution: Your account is not linked to an institution.
admin.empty: No group is large enough to show yet. Data appears once at least {{k}} students are in a group.
admin.assessmentNote: Educational self-assessments, not diagnoses. Chart shows the average score across shown groups.
admin.riskNote: Counts of crisis-support events in groups of {{k}} or more. Smaller counts are hidden.
admin.tableAssessment: Number of students per severity band and month
admin.tableMood: Number of students per mood and week
admin.tableRisk: Number of events per severity level and month
admin.hiddenCellsNote: Hidden groups are not drawn in the chart.
